teacher_info.about_teacher: I have 4 years of professional experience as an ESL teacher for students with a broad range of English ability. I've taught kids between the ages of 3 and 18 years old, but my preferred method of learning has always been conversation, so in my teaching, I like to focus on the way native speakers really talk. It's important to understand and be able to correctly utilize proper grammatical structures, so I make sure that the student has a grasp on proper speaking technique before moving on to more casual speaking patterns. I hope to help you improve your English through interesting conversation!
teacher_info.teaching_style: As these classes are conversation-based, I like to focus on practical use of English and pronunciation. I also like to base the conversation around topics that interest you, the student, as these will be most helpful to you when you speak English in the real world. Whether it be prepping for a job interview or discussing your favorite TV show with your friends, I want to be able to help you better express yourself in a new language.

pro_course_detail.title: Main Course Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
